Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

forecastdom (development version)

  • Added uspa_mh_test() and aspa_mh_test(), the uniform and average multi-horizon SPA tests of Quaedvlieg (2021), implemented with a moving-block bootstrap.
  • Bundled quaedvlieg2021, the example loss-differential paths from the paper’s replication archive.

Developed by Gabriel Cabrera.
